Main entry point wiring actions, tiles, callbacks, stages, and default config for fdctl.

# Purpose
This file defines the entry point for the `fdctl` application and connects the main command-line program to the rest of the Frankendancer code base. It sets the application name and binary name, then builds the lists of available topology object callbacks in `CALLBACKS`, configuration stages in `STAGES`, runtime tiles in `TILES`, and user actions in `ACTIONS`. These arrays expose the components that `fd_main` uses to initialize the topology, apply system configuration, start tiles, and dispatch commands such as `run`, `configure`, `monitor`, `keys`, `help`, and `version`.

The [`main`](<#main>) function creates a default configuration file entry from `fdctl_default_config` and passes it to `fd_main` together with `fd_topo_initialize`. This makes the file the startup point for the `fdctl` executable. The file also defines [`add_bench_topo`](<#add_bench_topo>), which is a placeholder function for bench topology setup. It accepts topology and benchmark parameters, but it does not use them in this build.
